purpose: Add quality/regime robustness metrics, ablations, interfaces, and task-owned Chrono diagnostic policy before any future offline test or formal-result access, without mutating Gate 0 v1.

authorization_scope_update.single_long_process_rule: Launch at most one long campaign/benchmark process and follow the same process to its final exit code; never duplicate it for progress visibility.
authorization_scope_update.campaign_consistency: One frozen task snapshot, runtime block, design identity assignment, and evidence root per case; reliability failure stops acceptance.

dataset_generation_plan.source_suite_contract: A v2 immutable config copies the Gate 0 v1 case/runner/nsga3 contracts and adds only the registered two-seed representation-dataset suite; default benchmark.toml remains unchanged
dataset_generation_plan.eligibility_rule: Union completed schema-compatible real rows from both immutable seed cells, group exact duplicate canonical design IDs, require at least 2800 unique designs per case, then apply the unchanged v1 assignment algorithm.
dataset_generation_plan.test_access: The sealing tool may validate/hash all eligible rows and assign opaque design IDs, but model/metric code cannot materialize test rows before thresholds are sealed.

roughness_features.second_difference_rms: RMS of the second finite difference divided by max(p95-p05, standard deviation, 1e-12)
roughness_features.high_frequency_energy_ratio: rFFT power in the highest frequency quartile divided by non-DC power
roughness_features.derivative_reversal_fraction: fraction of adjacent first differences whose product is negative

quality_regime_metrics.clean_target_high_frequency_leakage_rate: Among task-assessed smooth held-out fields, fraction whose predicted high-frequency energy ratio exceeds the sealed training/validation reference rule.
quality_regime_metrics.predicted_to_real_roughness_inflation: For each assessment stratum and field, ratio of median predicted roughness feature to median real roughness feature; report every feature and field before macro aggregation.

regime_classifier.probability_calibration_stage: 082609 on the independent calibration partition; 082608 reports uncalibrated validation diagnostics only

strata.boundary: validation designs whose 10 nearest train designs in canonical normalized-parameter Euclidean distance include both smooth and non-smooth labels; deterministic ties use design identity

quality_regime_metrics.aggregation: Compute each metric per design and field, then equal-weight fields; never weight by field point count. Report smooth/chatter/failure/boundary separately.

thresholds.reason: The descriptive noise audit is not a legal validation/threshold-pilot partition and no sealed 2800-design formal dataset exists yet.

implementation_may_start_only_after: full-grid representation thresholds are sealed from legal validation/pilot evidence
stored-grid consistency, legal off-grid truth, wall-clock, and memory thresholds are sealed

downstream_handoff.082609: Calibrate applicability/regime probability on independent calibration designs and check classification calibration plus ensemble epistemic spread; never infer trust from training loss, cost, or member min/max.
downstream_handoff.082611: Exclude low-P(smooth) candidates from qNEHVI exploitation or apply the preregistered conservative policy, while preserving an explicit real exploration quota; do not merely inflate variance.
downstream_handoff.082612: Retain v2 leakage/roughness/classifier/stratified metrics and all four robustness ablations; seal numeric thresholds only from legal validation/threshold-pilot evidence before test access.
